missions.title: Install the RAM
intro: Drag the RAM stick into the RAM slot.
success: RAM installed! Memory holds what the CPU is working on right now.

Motherboard/RamSlot.name: RAM slot
Motherboard/RamSlot.hint: The long slot is for memory (RAM): it holds what the CPU is working on right now.

missions.title: Identify the components
intro: Every computer needs four things: a processor, memory, storage, and a way to talk to people.
Put each part on the table where it belongs. Pick up any part to start.
success: You built the core of a computer: processor, memory, storage and input.

Motherboard/CpuSocket.name: CPU socket
Motherboard/CpuSocket.hint: The square socket is for the processor (CPU): it runs every instruction.

Motherboard/RamSlot.name: RAM slot
Motherboard/RamSlot.hint: The long slot is for memory (RAM): it holds what the CPU is working on right now.

Motherboard/M2Slot.name: M.2 storage slot
Motherboard/M2Slot.hint: The flat M.2 slot is for storage (the SSD): it keeps files and programs even when the power is off.

UsbPad.name: keyboard spot (USB port)
UsbPad.hint: The USB spot is for input and output devices: the keyboard is how a person gives the computer input.
